title: Symptom lesion network mapping, sLNM (Siddiqi 2021)
differences_from_source: The map is the partial correlation of the symptom score with each voxel's Fz, from a permutation GLM with a lesion-volume covariate (score permuted within datasets, 5000 permutations, voxel max-statistic FWE primary); a parametric p-value is never the primary inference here.
Leave-one-dataset-out maps and their convergence are added when there are at least two datasets of ten or more lesions.
Connectome QA chips (degree and PC1) are added.
description: Maps where connectivity with the lesion locations correlates with a symptom score, with out-of-sample validation against baselines.
